title: 美股盘前：油价回落托稳期指，CLS与RCL获强正反馈；Fed前高利率仍压制AI估值
summary: 截至08:04 ET综合核验，道指、标普500和纳指100期货分别上涨0.32%、0.19%和0.27%，WTI回落至101.05美元、10年期美债收益率4.98%；CLS涨逾12%、RCL涨4.6%、CDNS涨2%。盘后重点验证STX，beat概率评为中。

关键词云图

科技金融产创融合通信设备存储概念汽车制造充电桩半导体A股分化恒科偏弱期指转弱格力反证油价高位
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
油价回落但中东供应风险仍在
周一Brent收低，约07:20 CST WTI报101.42美元、跌0.33%，Brent报110.23美元、微涨0.03%；沙特与胡塞武装相关袭击令供应溢价仍处高位。
美股
科技、半导体与光通信推动美股收高
10月26日道指、标普500和纳指分别上涨0.28%、0.70%和0.83%，半导体指数涨2.8%、科技板块涨1.5%；Lumentum与Coherent约涨8%和6%，但Meta因AI融资计划跌1.9%。
政策
多部门完善科技金融体制
10月26日公开的多部门指导意见提出在北京、上海、粤港澳大湾区等区域强化科技金融服务和直接融资支持，政策利好科技企业融资，但落地节奏与资金成本仍需跟踪。
政策
科技部强调科技创新与产业创新深度融合
科技部10月26日政策问答强调企业牵头科研任务、成果转化和战略性新兴产业培育；对算力、先进制造和产业软件形成中期支撑，但不替代订单与盈利验证。
市场
A/H开盘修复，成长与恒科相对占优
09:30 CST连续竞价显示上证指数涨0.12%、创业板涨1.04%，恒生指数涨0.09%、恒生科技涨0.79%；成长与港股科技均强于各自大盘，但开盘时间仍短，需继续验证成交与回落承接。
美股
汽车、通信设备与存储位居隔夜排行前列
08:28 CST的Moomoo快照显示汽车制造+3.86%、通信设备+3.51%、半导体+2.60%；充电桩+4.46%、新能源汽车+4.04%、存储概念+3.30%。行业Bottom5由受监管自来水、啤酒、地区银行、太阳能与百货构成。
业绩
香农芯创高增获得开盘正反馈
09:30 CST香农芯创报112.00元、涨2.70%，高于109.06元前收，三季度高增获得初步价格确认；但AI高估值调整风险仍要求观察其能否守住开盘区间。
业绩
中兴通讯开盘上涨，但现金流压力仍需折价
09:30 CST中兴通讯A股报28.37元、涨1.21%，单季改善获得正反馈；但前三季度归母净利润同比-23.71%、经营现金流同比-59.78%，尚不足以升级为无条件看多。
业绩
多利科技高开确认汽车链映射
09:30 CST多利科技报15.83元、涨4.77%，盘初最高16.39元；三季度归母净利润同比+176.27%与隔夜汽车制造/充电桩强势形成一致映射，升级为看多候选，但需防高开回落。
业绩
格力电器低开确认盈利压力
09:30 CST格力电器报36.30元、跌2.37%，公告后负反馈与三季度归母净利润同比-43.31%一致，维持回避；未出现足以推翻盈利压力的行业催化。
风险
中国AI高估值调整仍约束科技追高
Reuters于10月26日20:02 CST报道，科创50较7月高点回落约40%，中国AI相关股票市值蒸发约4800亿美元，AI类股票占A/H市值约42%、成交约57%；这不是新的盘中触发，但属于首轮遗漏的重大风险背景，要求对科技反弹保持价格与盈利双重验证。来源：Reuters。
港股
HKEX方向扫描未发现足以改变主线的大型新增事件
对业绩、停复牌、澄清及重大交易进行定向核验，发现的宝石资本停牌与宝新金融私有化/复牌事项规模较小，未纳入核心判断；中兴通讯A/H双重上市事项已在公司业绩中合并处理。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘
现金市场上涨后，周二期指小幅转弱
约07:20 CST，道指、标普500和纳指100期货分别-0.13%、-0.11%和-0.02%；报价为约一小时延迟快照，显示追涨动能不足但尚非全面风险反转。
对照
排行代表股多数延续现金时段方向
对14个可核验代表符号的延迟/延长时段末笔查询与排行方向大体一致：CENN、CLRO、EAF、MSGY、TSLA、NOK、GEV、RMBS等仍为正；GCTS.WS未取得可比报价。该查询不是独立的盘后涨跌，故仅作延续性对照。
映射
A/H开盘转强，财报映射获初步确认
09:30 CST创业板涨1.04%、恒生科技涨0.79%；香农芯创、中兴通讯和多利科技分别涨2.70%、1.21%和4.77%，其中多利最强。格力跌2.37%确认消费反证；科技高估值风险意味着反弹仍需守住开盘区间。

开盘结论

成长与港股科技开盘修复，多利、香农和中兴对隔夜汽车、存储与通信映射给出正反馈。 格力低开确认消费盈利压力，Reuters揭示的AI高估值调整仍限制无条件追高。
短线以守住09:30开盘区间和板块宽度为验证门槛。 多利升级为看多候选；香农与中兴继续条件关注，若跌回前收或成长指数转弱则撤销升级。

重点个股关注

香农芯创
SZ.300475
条件关注
事实与状态：三季度高增对应隔夜存储概念+3.30%；09:30 CST报112.00元、涨2.70%，获得公告后初步正反馈。
确认条件：守住109.06元前收和09:30开盘区间，且存储/创业板宽度不转弱。
风险与失效：若回落跌破前收，或高增不能转化为订单和现金流，取消关注；AI高估值调整限制追高。
中兴通讯
SZ.000063 / HK.00763
条件关注
事实与状态：三季度收入和利润改善，09:30 CST A股报28.37元、涨1.21%；但前三季度利润和经营现金流仍下滑、存货增加。
确认条件：A股守住28.03元前收，或H股持续跑赢恒科，并出现成交承接。
风险与失效：若A/H双地均弱于指数，或库存与现金流压力继续被定价，维持观察而不升级。
多利科技
SZ.001311
看多候选
事实与状态：三季度归母净利润同比+176.27%，映射汽车制造+3.86%与充电桩+4.46%；09:30 CST报15.83元、涨4.77%，盘初最高16.39元。
确认条件：守住15.11元前收及15.70元盘初低点，成交承接且汽车零部件板块不转弱。
风险与失效：毛利率同比下降；若高开低走跌破15.70元并继续向前收回落，降回条件关注。
格力电器
SZ.000651
回避
事实与状态：三季度归母净利润同比下降43.31%；09:30 CST报36.30元、跌2.37%，公告后负反馈确认盈利压力。
确认条件：仅在重新站稳37.18元前收、且出现明确基本面解释与家电板块承接时，才从回避降为观察。
风险与失效：利润降幅显著，任何技术反弹均不能自动包装成多头。

板块轮动看板

相对受益
汽车零部件、存储与通信获得隔夜排行和本地开盘双重确认，多利强度最高。
条件进攻
多利为看多候选；香农与中兴保留条件关注，等待开盘区间与成交确认。
压力方向
家电消费仍受格力业绩与低开压制；高估值AI链虽反弹，仍面临拥挤与估值风险。
验证信号
创业板和恒科维持相对强势，三只正向候选守住前收，且多利不跌破15.70元盘初低点。

逻辑链

隔夜汽车、通信、半导体和存储领涨，为A/H成长修复提供外部映射。
09:30 CST创业板与恒科分别涨1.04%和0.79%，香农、中兴和多利均守住前收，开盘反馈转为正向。
多利涨4.77%且业绩增速与汽车/充电桩强势一致，升级为看多候选；格力跌2.37%，继续作为消费链负面反证。
Reuters所示AI高估值与拥挤度风险意味着修复不等于趋势反转，策略仍以守住开盘区间和板块宽度为门槛。

风险雷达

科创50较7月高点回落约40%，AI相关股票在A/H市值和成交中占比较高，估值与拥挤风险仍在。
09:30开盘样本时间短；若创业板、恒科或三只正向候选跌回前收，修复判断失效。
格力三季度利润同比下降43.31%且开盘跌2.37%，消费链盈利压力已获价格确认。
WTI仍在101美元上方，中东供应风险可能重新推高通胀与长端利率。

数据来源与时间点

Major News
Global
Oil eases, but Middle East supply risk remains
Brent settled lower Monday; around 07:20 CST WTI was $101.42, down 0.33%, while Brent was $110.23, up 0.03%. Saudi/Houthi-related attacks keep a sizable supply premium in place.
U.S.
Tech, semiconductors and optical networking lift U.S. stocks
On Oct 26, the Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq rose 0.28%, 0.70% and 0.83%. The semiconductor index gained 2.8% and tech rose 1.5%; Lumentum and Coherent advanced about 8% and 6%, while Meta fell 1.9% on its AI financing plan.
Policy
Multiple agencies strengthen the technology-finance framework
Multi-agency guidance published Oct 26 calls for stronger technology-finance services and direct-financing support in Beijing, Shanghai and the Greater Bay Area. It is supportive for tech funding, while implementation and funding costs still need monitoring.
Policy
MOST emphasizes deeper integration of technology and industry
A MOST policy Q&A on Oct 26 stresses enterprise-led research, commercialization and strategic emerging industries. This supports computing, advanced manufacturing and industrial software, but does not replace order and earnings verification.
Market
A/H markets rebound at the open, led by growth and HSTECH
At 09:30 CST, Shanghai was up 0.12% and ChiNext 1.04%, while the Hang Seng gained 0.09% and HSTECH 0.79%. Growth and Hong Kong tech outperformed their benchmarks, though the opening sample remains short and needs volume and pullback confirmation.
U.S.
Autos, communications equipment and storage lead overnight rankings
Moomoo's 08:28 CST snapshot shows Auto Manufacturers +3.86%, Communication Equipment +3.51% and Semiconductors +2.60%; EV Charging +4.46%, Electric Vehicles +4.04% and Data Storage +3.30%. The industry bottom five are Regulated Water, Brewers, Regional Banks, Solar and Department Stores.
Earnings
Shannon Semi receives positive opening feedback after strong earnings
At 09:30 CST, Shannon Semi traded at RMB112.00, up 2.70% and above its RMB109.06 prior close, providing initial post-filing confirmation. Elevated AI valuations still require it to hold the opening range.
Earnings
ZTE opens higher, but cash-flow pressure still warrants a discount
At 09:30 CST, ZTE A-shares traded at RMB28.37, up 1.21%, a positive response to the quarterly improvement. Yet nine-month attributable profit fell 23.71% and operating cash flow 59.78%, preventing an unconditional bullish upgrade.
Earnings
Duoli gaps higher and confirms the auto-chain mapping
At 09:30 CST, Duoli traded at RMB15.83, up 4.77%, after touching RMB16.39. Q3 attributable profit growth of 176.27% aligns with overnight auto-manufacturing and EV-charging strength, upgrading it to a bullish candidate while leaving gap-fade risk.
Earnings
Gree gaps lower and confirms the earnings pressure
At 09:30 CST, Gree traded at RMB36.30, down 2.37%. The negative post-filing response aligns with the 43.31% year-over-year Q3 profit decline, so it remains an avoid; no sector catalyst has offset the earnings pressure.
Risk
China AI valuation reset still constrains chasing tech
Reuters reported at 20:02 CST on Oct 26 that the STAR50 had fallen about 40% from its July high and roughly $480 billion in value had been erased; AI-related shares represented about 42% of A/H market capitalization and 57% of turnover. This is not a new intraday trigger, but it was a material first-run omission and requires both price and earnings confirmation for any tech rebound. Source: Reuters.
HKEX
HKEX directional scan finds no large new event that changes the thesis
A directional check of results, suspensions/resumptions, clarifications and major transactions found smaller-cap events involving Baoshi Capital and a privatization/resumption case, neither material enough for the core thesis. ZTE's dual A/H listing is addressed in the company earnings item.

U.S. Overnight Summary

Futures
Futures edge lower after a stronger cash session
Around 07:20 CST, Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures were down 0.13%, 0.11% and 0.02%. The snapshot was delayed by about an hour, indicating limited chase momentum rather than a broad risk reversal.
Cross-check
Most ranking representatives retain their cash-session direction
Delayed/extended-session last prints for 14 verifiable representative symbols broadly match the ranking direction: CENN, CLRO, EAF, MSGY, TSLA, NOK, GEV and RMBS remained positive; a comparable GCTS.WS quote was unavailable. These are not independent after-hours returns and are used only as continuity checks.
A/H map
A/H open strengthens and earnings mappings receive initial confirmation
At 09:30 CST, ChiNext rose 1.04% and HSTECH 0.79%. Shannon Semi, ZTE and Duoli gained 2.70%, 1.21% and 4.77%, with Duoli strongest. Gree fell 2.37%, confirming the consumer counter-signal; elevated tech valuations still require opening-range support.

Opening View

Growth and Hong Kong tech rebounded at the open, while Duoli, Shannon Semi and ZTE gave positive read-throughs for autos, storage and communications. Gree's gap-down confirms consumer earnings pressure, and Reuters' AI valuation-reset evidence still limits unconditional chasing.
Use the 09:30 opening range and sector breadth as the short-term validation threshold. Duoli is upgraded to a bullish candidate; Shannon Semi and ZTE remain conditional watches, with upgrades revoked if they lose prior closes or growth indices weaken.

Stocks to Watch

香农芯创
SZ.300475
Conditional Watch
Facts & status: Strong Q3 growth maps to overnight Data Storage (+3.30%); at 09:30 CST the stock traded at RMB112.00, up 2.70%, providing initial post-filing confirmation.
Confirmation: Hold the RMB109.06 prior close and the 09:30 opening range, while storage and ChiNext breadth do not weaken.
Risk & invalidation: Cancel the watch if it loses the prior close or growth fails to translate into orders and cash flow; the AI valuation reset limits chasing.
中兴通讯
SZ.000063 / HK.00763
Conditional Watch
Facts & status: Q3 revenue and profit improved; the A-share traded at RMB28.37, up 1.21%, at 09:30 CST. Nine-month profit and operating cash flow still fell and inventory rose.
Confirmation: The A-share holds its RMB28.03 prior close, or the H-share continues to outperform HSTECH with visible turnover support.
Risk & invalidation: If both listings lag their benchmarks or inventory and cash-flow pressure is repriced, keep it as observation rather than upgrading.
多利科技
SZ.001311
Bullish Candidate
Facts & status: Q3 attributable profit rose 176.27%, mapping to Auto Manufacturers (+3.86%) and EV Charging (+4.46%); at 09:30 CST it traded at RMB15.83, up 4.77%, after touching RMB16.39.
Confirmation: Hold the RMB15.11 prior close and the RMB15.70 early-session low, with turnover support and no reversal in auto-parts breadth.
Risk & invalidation: Gross margin declined year over year. Downgrade to conditional watch if the gap fades below RMB15.70 and continues toward the prior close.
格力电器
SZ.000651
Avoid
Facts & status: Q3 attributable profit fell 43.31%; at 09:30 CST the stock traded at RMB36.30, down 2.37%, confirming earnings pressure.
Confirmation: Only move from avoid to watch if it regains the RMB37.18 prior close with a clear fundamental explanation and home-appliance sector support.
Risk & invalidation: The profit decline is material; any technical rebound must not be automatically framed as bullish.

Sector Rotation Board

Relative beneficiaries
Auto parts, storage and communications receive both overnight-ranking and local-opening confirmation, with Duoli strongest.
Conditional offense
Duoli is a bullish candidate; Shannon Semi and ZTE remain conditional watches pending opening-range and turnover confirmation.
Pressure areas
Home appliances remain constrained by Gree's earnings and gap-down; high-valuation AI names face crowding and valuation risk despite the rebound.
Validation signals
ChiNext and HSTECH retain relative strength, all three positive candidates hold prior closes, and Duoli stays above the RMB15.70 early low.

Logic Chain

Overnight leadership in autos, communications, semiconductors and storage provides an external mapping for A/H growth recovery.
At 09:30 CST, ChiNext and HSTECH gained 1.04% and 0.79%, while Shannon Semi, ZTE and Duoli all held above prior closes, turning opening feedback positive.
Duoli rose 4.77% with earnings growth aligned to auto and EV-charging strength, earning a bullish-candidate upgrade; Gree fell 2.37% and remains a consumer counter-signal.
Reuters' evidence on AI valuations and crowding means a rebound is not a trend reversal; the opening range and sector breadth remain the key thresholds.

Risk Radar

The STAR50 is about 40% below its July high, while AI-related shares carry large A/H market-cap and turnover weights; valuation and crowding risk remain.
The 09:30 opening sample is short; the rebound thesis fails if ChiNext, HSTECH or the three positive candidates lose their prior closes.
Gree's Q3 profit fell 43.31% and the stock opened down 2.37%, confirming consumer earnings pressure.
WTI remains above $101, and Middle East supply risk could re-accelerate inflation and long-end yields.
